Notes: Pioneer Historian (OMIM), Arrival hall (4604) at (183.4, 1.0, 175.4). Rebuilt from 4 QuestDialogCapture dumps (Pioneer_Historian_OMIM, 2026-10-20, characters Soldaman, Aweadae, no quest state). Picking a faction is followed in retail by a faction set and a teleport to a backyard; the script format has no teleport or faction effect, so only the dialog is scripted.

tell_backyards.Text: Can you tell me more about Backyards?

welcome.Text: Welcome to Rubi-ka, fellow colonist! Are you planning on boarding the shuttle like everyone else?

Text: Well, let me tell you, it's not the only option!
{delay 2} Over there, is the walkway through to the transport bound for the Shuttleport, just off the mainland terraformed portion of Rubi-ka.
{delay 2} And there, you have the representatives sent by JOBE, scientists and researchers who are diving into the mysterious Shadowlands.
{delay 3} But, what if I told you, there was a third option?
{delay 1}\n{emote}She grins at you.{/emote}
Backyards!
{delay 1} The true pioneer colonist experience!
{delay 2} You get to experience the world as it was for the first Rubi-kan colonists decades ago before the more recent infrastructure was built to offload our newest citizens.
{delay 1} What do you say? Interested?\n\n

{delay 1}{emote}<font color=#FF0000>The backyard start will lock access to the ICC Shuttleport and it's various items and benefits. You will also not be granted any profession specific start-up items. Please be certain you wish to commit to this start before continuing.</font>{/emote}
Of course.
{delay 1} 'Backyards' was a term given to the training areas for new colonists upon their arrival to Rubi-ka, before ICC had built the Shuttleport.
{delay 1} They still exist today, but are much quieter following the streamlining of the colonist onboarding process.
{delay 2} It's quite sad really...
{delay 2}\nAnyway, you will still find an ample amount of local fauna just waiting to be greeted with your weapon of choice!
Fantastic! It just so happens that I'm quite the accomplished Nano-technician too, so, can send you directly to the backyard of your choosing,
{delay 1} but first,
{delay 1} what faction would you like to align with?
Wonderful, hold still now and I will begin the program to teleport you there.
{delay 1} Good luck, Pioneer!
